title: PDF Document Upload and Storage
description: The system must allow users to upload PDF documents into the application, storing them securely in S3-compatible object storage for viewing and signature processing.
acceptance_criteria: Users can upload valid PDF files.
Uploaded documents are securely stored in S3 object storage.
The system handles file upload errors gracefully.

title: Interactive PDF Document Viewing
description: The web application must render PDF documents natively in the client browser using pdf.js to enable document review and field placement.
acceptance_criteria: PDF pages render accurately in the web browser using pdf.js.
Users can navigate through document pages.
Document zooming and page rendering operate smoothly across modern web browsers.

title: PDF Field Placement and Manipulation
description: The system must enable users and admins to place signature fields and manipulate PDF layers prior to sending documents out for signature.
acceptance_criteria: Users can place fields onto specific coordinates on PDF pages.
PDF manipulation preserves original document layout using @cantoo/pdf-lib.

title: Digital PDF Cryptographic Signing
description: The platform must cryptographically sign PDF documents upon completion of all recipient inputs using @libpdf/core.
acceptance_criteria: Digital signatures are cryptographically embedded into the PDF file upon completion.
Document tamper evidence is verified upon signature execution.

title: Transactional Email Notification Delivery
description: The system must send automated transactional emails for signing invitations, signature completion, and document updates using react-email templates.
acceptance_criteria: Recipients receive invitation emails with direct links to sign documents.
All parties receive completion confirmation emails once a document is fully signed.
Emails are rendered using standard react-email HTML templates.

title: Multi-Language Internationalization Support
description: The user interface must support multi-language internationalization and localization using Lingui to serve global users.
acceptance_criteria: UI strings are localized using Lingui translation keys.
Users can select or automatically detect their preferred language locale.

title: Self-Hosted Deployment via Docker Containers
description: The software must be packaged as standard Docker container images allowing users to self-host the platform on Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, or cloud platforms.
acceptance_criteria: Official Docker images are distributed via DockerHub and GitHub Container Registry.
The application runs successfully via docker-compose.

title: Subscription Billing and Payment Integration
description: The system must integrate with Stripe to manage payment processing, cloud subscriptions, and enterprise account billing.
acceptance_criteria: Users can purchase paid plans via Stripe checkout.
Subscription statuses update automatically via Stripe webhooks.

title: Enterprise Dedicated Hosting and Control
description: The platform must provide enterprise-grade operational flexibility, custom contract options, and enhanced administrative controls for large organizations.
acceptance_criteria: Enterprise options allow customized deployment options.
Dedicated contact and onboarding workflows are supported for enterprise customers.

title: Relational Data Management with PostgreSQL
description: The application must persist user account data, document metadata, signatures, and configuration settings in a PostgreSQL database managed via Prisma ORM.
acceptance_criteria: Database schema migrations run cleanly via Prisma.
System persists audit trails and recipient records in PostgreSQL.

title: High-Performance Hono and tRPC API
description: The platform must expose type-safe internal and external web APIs powered by Hono and tRPC servers.
acceptance_criteria: Client-server communication uses end-to-end type safety via tRPC.
HTTP requests are routed and handled efficiently via Hono server.

title: Local Development Email Testing Environment
description: The development environment must capture outgoing emails locally using an Inbucket SMTP docker container for developer testing.
acceptance_criteria: Outgoing emails during local development are caught by Inbucket.
Developers can inspect email HTML output on http://localhost:9000.

title: Private Security Vulnerability Reporting Workflow
description: The platform must support secure vulnerability disclosures via GitHub Security Advisories to protect self-hosted and cloud installations.
acceptance_criteria: Security policy guidelines are accessible in the repository.
Vulnerability submissions can be routed privately through GitHub Security Advisories.

description: The platform must support distinct recipient roles including SIGNER, VIEWER, APPROVER, ASSISTANT, and CC.
acceptance_criteria: Sender can select recipient role from SIGNER, VIEWER, APPROVER, ASSISTANT, CC
Role limits and grants corresponding permissions/actions for each recipient
Recipient payload includes role field
SIGNER role requires mandatory signature/field completion
APPROVER role requires approval before lower signing order participants can proceed
VIEWER role allows document viewing without requiring form action
CC role receives a copy of the completed document with no action required
ASSISTANT role permits filling fields on behalf of another recipient

title: Configurable Signature Input Options
description: The system must allow document creators to enable or disable specific signature input methods: typed, uploaded image, or drawn signatures.
acceptance_criteria: Sender can toggle typedSignatureEnabled boolean
Sender can toggle uploadSignatureEnabled boolean
Sender can toggle drawSignatureEnabled boolean
Signer UI restricts signature capture options based on document settings

title: Parallel and Sequential Signing Orders
description: The system must support both PARALLEL (simultaneous) and SEQUENTIAL (ordered) signing workflows for document recipients.
acceptance_criteria: Sender can select PARALLEL or SEQUENTIAL signing order
In SEQUENTIAL mode, signing links are routed based on signingOrder integer
In PARALLEL mode, all signers receive links simultaneously

title: Allow Signers to Dictate Next Signer
description: The system must provide an option allowing current signers to choose or delegate the next recipient in the signing flow.
acceptance_criteria: Sender can toggle allowDictateNextSigner boolean on document metadata
When enabled, current signer can specify the next signer's details during signing

title: Document Password Access Protection
description: The platform must support password protection on documents to restrict document access to authorized recipients.
acceptance_criteria: Sender can specify a password for document metadata
Recipients are prompted for password prior to viewing document

title: Custom Post-Signing Redirect URL
description: The platform must allow configuring a custom redirect URL where signers are redirected after completing document actions.
acceptance_criteria: Sender can specify redirectUrl in document metadata
Signer is redirected to redirectUrl upon successful action completion

title: Per-Recipient Authentication Options
description: The platform must support per-recipient access authentication (accessAuth) and action authentication (actionAuth) controls.
acceptance_criteria: Sender can set accessAuth and actionAuth per recipient
Recipient authentication settings are evaluated before document access or action execution

title: Recipient Signing Link Expiration Tracking
description: The platform must manage recipient link expiration timestamps (expiresAt) and record when expiration notifications are sent (expirationNotifiedAt).
acceptance_criteria: Recipient tokens store optional expiresAt timestamp
expirationNotifiedAt records timestamp when expiration email notice is sent
Expired links prevent signing access

title: Document Timezone and Date Format Configuration
description: The system must allow senders to configure custom display timezone and date format preferences for dates appearing on documents.
acceptance_criteria: Sender can set timezone string (e.g. UTC, Etc/UTC)
Sender can set dateFormat string (e.g. MM/DD/YYYY, yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm a)
Date fields on document display formatted according to configuration

title: Custom Document Language and Email Settings
description: The platform must allow senders to set document language code and configure custom email settings, subject, and message.
acceptance_criteria: Sender can configure language code (e.g. 'en')
Sender can specify email subject and body message
Sender can configure emailSettings object per document

title: Standardized Webhook Payload Structure
description: All webhook notifications must contain a standard top-level JSON structure including event, payload, createdAt, and webhookEndpoint fields.
acceptance_criteria: Top-level payload includes event (string)
Top-level payload includes payload (object)
Top-level payload includes createdAt (ISO datetime)
Top-level payload includes webhookEndpoint (URL string)

title: Restrict Webhook Management to Team Accounts
description: Webhook configuration and management features must be exclusively accessible to team accounts, explicitly blocking personal accounts from creating or managing webhooks.
acceptance_criteria: Team accounts can view and access the Webhooks tab in Team Settings.
Personal accounts do not have access to Webhook settings or configuration menus.

title: Create Webhook Endpoint via Team Dashboard
description: Provide a user interface within Team Settings allowing team administrators to configure a new HTTP/HTTPS webhook endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: User can navigate to Team settings > Webhooks.
User can click 'Create Webhook' button to open configuration dialog.
User can enter Webhook URL, select subscribed events, and optionally enter a Secret key.
Webhook becomes active upon clicking 'Create Webhook'.

title: Configure Webhook Payload Signing Secret
description: Allow users to specify an optional secret key during webhook setup to sign event payloads with the X-Documenso-Secret header for endpoint security verification.
acceptance_criteria: Optional 'Secret' input field is present in the webhook creation/edit dialog.
Documenso includes signature verification headers in webhook requests when a secret is configured.

title: Document Lifecycle Webhook Events
description: Documenso must send webhook notifications for document status and action changes including creation, sending, opening, signing, recipient completion, document completion, rejection, cancellation, and reminders.
acceptance_criteria: User can select 'DOCUMENT_CREATED' to receive payloads when a document is created.
User can select 'DOCUMENT_SENT' to receive payloads when sent to recipients.
User can select 'DOCUMENT_OPENED' to receive payloads when opened by a recipient.
User can select 'DOCUMENT_SIGNED' to receive payloads when signed by a recipient.
User can select 'DOCUMENT_RECIPIENT_COMPLETED' when an individual recipient finishes required actions.
User can select 'DOCUMENT_COMPLETED' when all recipients complete required actions.
User can select 'DOCUMENT_REJECTED' when a recipient rejects a document.
User can select 'DOCUMENT_CANCELLED' when a document owner deletes a document.
User can select 'DOCUMENT_REMINDER_SENT' when a reminder email is dispatched.
Documenso dispatches 'DOCUMENT_CREATED' event when a document is created.
Documenso dispatches 'DOCUMENT_SENT' event when a document is sent to recipients.
Documenso dispatches 'DOCUMENT_OPENED' event when a recipient views the document.
Documenso dispatches 'DOCUMENT_SIGNED' event when a field/document is signed.
Documenso dispatches 'DOCUMENT_RECIPIENT_COMPLETED' event when an individual recipient finishes signing.
Documenso dispatches 'DOCUMENT_COMPLETED' event when all recipients complete signing.
Documenso dispatches 'DOCUMENT_REJECTED' event when a recipient declines/rejects the document.
Documenso dispatches 'DOCUMENT_CANCELLED' event when the document is voided or cancelled.
Documenso dispatches 'DOCUMENT_REMINDER_SENT' event when a signing reminder is dispatched.

title: Subscribe to Template Event Webhooks
description: Support webhook event subscriptions for template operations including creation, updates, deletion, and usage.
acceptance_criteria: User can select 'TEMPLATE_CREATED' to receive notifications when a template is created.
User can select 'TEMPLATE_UPDATED' to receive notifications when a template is modified.
User can select 'TEMPLATE_DELETED' to receive notifications when a template is deleted.
User can select 'TEMPLATE_USED' to receive notifications when a document is generated from a template.

title: Enforce Webhook Endpoint Technical Requirements
description: Webhook delivery system must enforce HTTPS in production environments, dispatch JSON payloads via HTTP POST, and require receiving servers to return 2xx status within 30 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Production webhook endpoints must use the HTTPS protocol.
Webhook payloads are sent via HTTP POST with 'Content-Type: application/json'.
Requests time out if endpoint does not respond within 30 seconds.

title: Test Webhook Endpoint Dispatch
description: Provide a manual testing mechanism within the dashboard allowing users to select an event type and dispatch simulated test payloads to an active webhook endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: User can select a specific webhook from Team Settings > Webhooks.
User can click a 'Test' button.
User can select an event type from a dropdown menu.
User can click 'Send' to dispatch realistic test sample data to the endpoint.
Dispatched test call appears in the webhook logs.

title: View Webhook Delivery Call Logs
description: Display a historical log of all delivery attempts for each webhook subscription, detailed with status, timestamps, response codes, headers, and request/response payloads.
acceptance_criteria: User can view a log list for any configured webhook subscription.
Logs accurately show delivery status (success/failure), event type, timestamp, and HTTP response code.
User can click on a log entry to inspect full request headers, request payload body, and endpoint response payload.

title: Manually Resend Failed Webhooks
description: Allow users to trigger a manual retry of a specific historical failed or past webhook delivery attempt directly from the call log details page.
acceptance_criteria: User can open a specific webhook log entry.
User can click a 'Resend' button.
Documenso re-dispatches the exact payload to the configured endpoint URL and records a new log entry.

title: Automatic Webhook Retry Exponential Backoff
description: Automatically retry failed webhook delivery attempts up to 5 times using a predefined exponential backoff schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Failed delivery attempt 1 is followed by attempt 2 after 1 minute.
Attempt 3 occurs after 5 minutes.
Attempt 4 occurs after 30 minutes.
Attempt 5 occurs after 2 hours.
Webhook call is marked permanently failed after 5 failed attempts without further automatic retries.

title: Webhook Secret Signing Header
description: Documenso must include the configured webhook secret in every outgoing webhook HTTP POST request via the X-Documenso-Secret header to allow receivers to verify authenticity.
acceptance_criteria: Documenso includes the 'X-Documenso-Secret' HTTP header on all webhook dispatch requests.
If a secret was specified during webhook configuration, the header contains that exact secret string.
If no secret was configured, the header value is set to an empty string.

title: Template Lifecycle Webhook Events
description: Documenso must trigger webhook notifications for actions performed on templates, including creation, updates, deletion, and usage.
acceptance_criteria: Documenso dispatches 'TEMPLATE_CREATED' event upon template creation.
Documenso dispatches 'TEMPLATE_UPDATED' event upon template modification.
Documenso dispatches 'TEMPLATE_DELETED' event upon template removal.
Documenso dispatches 'TEMPLATE_USED' event when a document is generated from a template.

title: Webhook Payload Delivery Format
description: Documenso webhook payloads must be delivered via HTTP POST requests with Content-Type application/json containing event identifier, payload object, and timestamp details.
acceptance_criteria: Webhook request body uses Content-Type 'application/json'.
The body contains a top-level 'event' field with the valid event type name.
The body contains a top-level 'payload' object with event context data.
The body contains or supports a top-level 'createdAt' ISO timestamp field.

title: Webhook Secret Key Configuration and Rotation
description: Users must be able to configure and update a secret string for webhook endpoints to enable constant-time string comparison verification on target servers.
acceptance_criteria: User can input a custom secret string (such as a 32-byte hex string) when setting up a webhook.
User can update or rotate the webhook secret in Documenso UI/API.
Secrets are stored and transmitted using UTF-8 encoding.

title: Get Envelope Recipient by ID
description: Retrieve a single recipient by their recipient ID via API, including full recipient metadata and associated fields.
acceptance_criteria: System handles GET requests at /api/v2/envelope/recipient/{recipientId}
Request must include valid Authorization API key header
Response includes recipient id, envelopeId, email, name, role, signingOrder, token, signedAt, readStatus, signingStatus, sendStatus, and field objects
Returns HTTP 404 if recipient or envelope is not found

title: Create Multiple Envelope Recipients
description: Add one or more recipients to an existing envelope in a single API call.
acceptance_criteria: System handles POST requests at /api/v2/envelope/recipient/create-many
Request body requires envelopeId and data array containing recipient objects
Recipient objects require email, name, and role
Recipient display name must not exceed 255 characters
Supports optional signingOrder, accessAuth, and actionAuth parameters
Returns generated recipient objects including unique signing tokens and default statuses (NOT_OPENED, NOT_SIGNED, NOT_SENT)
Returns HTTP 400 if recipient already exists or payload is invalid

title: Update Multiple Envelope Recipients
description: Modify details for one or more recipients on an uncompleted envelope.
acceptance_criteria: System handles POST requests at /api/v2/envelope/recipient/update-many
Request body requires envelopeId and array of update objects with recipient id
Allows updating email, name, role, signingOrder, accessAuth, and actionAuth
Modifications are rejected with HTTP 400 error if the envelope is already completed
Returns array of updated recipient objects

title: Delete Envelope Recipient
description: Remove an existing recipient from an uncompleted envelope via API.
acceptance_criteria: System handles POST requests at /api/v2/envelope/recipient/delete
Request body requires recipientId
Deletion succeeds and returns { "success": true } if envelope is incomplete
Rejects deletion with HTTP 400 error if envelope is already completed

title: Sequential Signing Order Workflow
description: Control document progression order using numeric signingOrder parameters assigned to recipients.
acceptance_criteria: Recipients with lower signingOrder values sign before recipients with higher values
Recipients with identical signingOrder values can sign concurrently
APPROVER recipients block signers with higher order numbers until approved
CC recipients receive notification/document after all signing operations complete

title: Configure Recipient Access Authentication
description: Restrict access to document viewing based on defined authentication constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Supports ACCOUNT access authentication forcing recipient login
Supports TWO_FACTOR_AUTH access authentication requiring 2FA verification prior to viewing document
Enforces configured accessAuth rules when a user attempts to open the document link

title: Configure Recipient Action Authentication
description: Require identity verification before a recipient can sign or complete an action on a document.
acceptance_criteria: Supports ACCOUNT action authentication requiring recipient login
Supports PASSKEY action authentication requiring passkey verification
Supports TWO_FACTOR_AUTH action authentication requiring 2FA code
Supports PASSWORD action authentication requiring password entry
Supports EXPLICIT_NONE to explicitly disable action authentication requirements

title: Track Recipient Status and Timestamps
description: Maintain granular status flags for envelope recipients across read, signing, and delivery states.
acceptance_criteria: Track readStatus as NOT_OPENED or OPENED
Track signingStatus as NOT_SIGNED, SIGNED, or REJECTED
Track sendStatus as NOT_SENT or SENT
Store signedAt ISO timestamp when signing occurs

title: Enforce Recipient Display Name Character Limit
description: Limit recipient display names to a maximum length of 255 characters.
acceptance_criteria: Validation rejects recipient creation/update if name length > 255 characters
API returns HTTP 400 error on validation failure

title: Immutable Completed Envelope Recipients
description: Prevent adding, updating, or deleting recipients on envelopes that have reached completed status.
acceptance_criteria: Attempts to update or delete recipients on completed envelopes return HTTP 400 error
Error response indicates envelope is already completed

title: List and Filter Templates API
description: Retrieve a paginated list of templates with support for filtering by type (PRIVATE or PUBLIC) and folder ID, as well as sorting by creation date.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint GET /template returns paginated template list with pagination metadata (page, perPage, totalPages, totalItems)
Supports query parameter 'page' defaulting to 1
Supports query parameter 'perPage' defaulting to 10 with maximum of 100
Supports query parameter 'type' to filter by PRIVATE or PUBLIC
Supports query parameter 'folderId' to filter by folder
Supports 'orderByColumn' (createdAt) and 'orderByDirection' ('asc' or 'desc', default 'desc')

title: Retrieve Single Template Details API
description: Fetch complete template object details by its template ID, including recipients, pre-placed fields, visibility, and template metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint GET /template/{templateId} accepts numeric template ID in path
Returns full template object including fields, recipients, templateMeta, and directLink configurations

title: Create Document from Template API
description: Generate and optionally distribute a new signing document from a template, mapping recipient data to defined template recipient slots.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint POST /template/use accepts templateId and array of recipients (id, email, name)
Supports 'distributeDocument' boolean parameter to immediately send document upon creation
Supports 'externalId' parameter for custom tracking identifiers
Supports 'folderId' parameter to place the newly created document in a specified folder
Returns generated document object with ID, status, and signing URLs for recipients

title: PDF Placeholder Limitation on Template API
description: Document creation from templates via POST /template/use does not support PDF placeholder parsing.
acceptance_criteria: POST /template/use does not process PDF text placeholders for field positioning
Clients requiring placeholder parsing must use POST /envelope/create instead

title: Override Template Settings during Document Creation
description: Override template-level settings when creating a document, including title, email communications, localized formatting, and signature input modes.
acceptance_criteria: Allows overriding document title, email subject, and email message body
Allows overriding timezone and dateFormat strings
Allows overriding redirectUrl post-signing and document language code
Allows toggling allowed signature methods: typedSignatureEnabled, uploadSignatureEnabled, drawSignatureEnabled

title: Prefill Template Field Values
description: Populate initial field values for template fields prior to generating and sending the document.
acceptance_criteria: Supports prefilling text fields with string values
Supports prefilling number fields with numeric values as strings
Supports prefilling date fields with YYYY-MM-DD ISO date strings
Supports prefilling radio fields with single selected option string
Supports prefilling checkbox fields with array of checked option strings
Supports prefilling dropdown fields with selected option string
Supports optional label and placeholder overrides during prefill

title: Prefill Field Type Validation Constraint
description: Strict type matching constraint requiring field types specified in prefillFields to match the corresponding template field type.
acceptance_criteria: API validates that the field type in prefillFields matches the template's field type ID
Returns an error if prefill field type mismatches template field type definition

title: Update Template Settings API
description: Update general template properties and email/redirect metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint POST /template/update accepts templateId, data object, and meta object
Allows updating template title and visibility permissions
Allows updating template meta options such as email subject and redirect URL

title: Duplicate Template API
description: Clone an existing template along with its recipients, fields, and configuration settings into a new template.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint POST /template/duplicate accepts templateId
Returns newly created duplicate template object with new template ID

title: Delete Template API
description: Permanently remove a template by ID.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint POST /template/delete accepts templateId
Returns success status boolean upon successful template deletion

title: Create Direct Link Template API
description: Generate a direct link template that automatically creates and initiates a signing document when accessed by recipients.
acceptance_criteria: Endpoint POST /template/direct/create configures self-service signing links
Enables automated creation of document upon visiting direct link URL

title: Template Visibility Permission Levels
description: Control template viewing access using granular visibility levels within an organization.
acceptance_criteria: Template visibility supports EVERYONE, ADMIN, and MANAGER_AND_ABOVE settings
Template types support PRIVATE or PUBLIC classifications

title: One-Time API Token Display
description: Display newly generated API tokens only once upon creation, instructing the user to copy and store it securely.
acceptance_criteria: Show the token value immediately after creation
Display warning that the token cannot be viewed again after navigating away
Allow user to copy the token value to clipboard

title: Revoke API Token
description: Allow users to revoke an active API token from the settings interface to immediately invalidate its access.
acceptance_criteria: User can view active tokens under Settings > API Tokens
User can click the delete icon next to a specific token
System prompts for confirmation before revoking
Revoked tokens immediately reject incoming requests with a 401 Unauthorized error

title: Authorization Header Request Authentication
description: Authenticate API requests using the API token supplied in the standard Authorization HTTP header.
acceptance_criteria: API accepts authorization via header: Authorization: api_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
Valid token authorizes API operation for the token owner
Invalid or missing authorization header returns 401 Unauthorized

title: Full Account Scope API Token Constraint
description: API tokens carry full account permissions equivalent to the token owner, with no scoped or granular permission restrictions supported.
acceptance_criteria: API token grants access to create, read, update, and delete documents
API token grants access to manage recipients and fields
API token grants access to manage templates
API token grants access to team resources if owner has team access

title: Free Tier API Document Limit
description: Restrict document creation via API to a maximum of 5 documents per month for Free account tiers.
acceptance_criteria: Free accounts are granted API access capabilities
System limits document operations to 5 documents per month for Free tier
Users are prompted to upgrade to a paid plan for higher limits

title: Multi-Environment API v2 Endpoints
description: Provide v2 API endpoints supporting Production, Staging, and Self-hosted deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Production API available at https://app.documenso.com/api/v2
Staging API available at https://stg-app.documenso.com/api/v2
Self-hosted API available at https://your-domain.com/api/v2

title: API Authentication Error Responses
description: Provide clear HTTP error response codes and reasons for authentication and authorization failures.
acceptance_criteria: Return 401 Unauthorized when Authorization header is missing or token is invalid
Return 401 Unauthorized when supplied token is expired
Return 403 Forbidden when trying to access resources not owned by the token account

title: SDK Client Authentication Support
description: Provide official SDKs for TypeScript, Python, and Go that manage API key authentication headers automatically.
acceptance_criteria: TypeScript SDK accepts apiKey parameter on instantiation
Python and Go SDKs handle token headers natively
SDK automatically formats Authorization header for requests

title: API v1 Deprecation Constraint
description: API v1 is deprecated and restricted strictly to legacy documents created prior to the envelope system.
acceptance_criteria: New integrations are directed to use API v2
API v1 endpoints only function for legacy non-envelope documents
OpenAPI v1 reference is maintained for legacy migration

title: API Token Authentication
description: Authenticate API requests using an API token provided in the Authorization header. Tokens require the 'api_' prefix.
acceptance_criteria: API accepts valid API tokens provided in the Authorization header
API returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized if the API token is invalid, missing, or missing the 'api_' prefix

title: PDF Only Document Upload
description: The platform strictly accepts PDF documents for sending and creation, without converting non-PDF file formats automatically.
acceptance_criteria: System accepts valid PDF uploads
System rejects non-PDF file formats with HTTP 400 and error message 'Invalid file type. Only PDF files are supported.'

title: Direct Recipient Signing Requirement
description: The API and system enforce that recipients must sign documents themselves; API calls cannot execute signature actions on behalf of recipients.
acceptance_criteria: Recipients sign documents independently via unique signing links
No endpoint exists to programmatically execute signatures on behalf of recipients

title: Signed PDF Download Availability Constraint
description: The signed PDF document cannot be retrieved or downloaded until all assigned recipients have completed their required actions.
acceptance_criteria: Retrieval of completed PDF remains restricted while document status is in DRAFT or PENDING
Signed PDF becomes available for download only after all recipients complete signing/approval

title: List Account Envelopes
description: Retrieve a paginated list of envelopes/documents created within the account, including metadata and current status.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v2/envelope returns an array of envelopes containing id, status, title, and createdAt
Response includes pagination details containing page, perPage, totalPages, and totalItems

title: Single-Call Envelope Creation
description: Create an envelope with an attached PDF document, recipient details, and positioned fields in a single multipart API request.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v2/envelope/create accepts multipart/form-data with 'payload' JSON and 'files' binary PDF
Returns created envelope object with envelope ID in DRAFT status

title: Percentage-Based Field Positioning
description: Specify field coordinates and dimensions on PDF documents using relative percentage values (0-100) along with 1-based page numbers and 0-based document file indices.
acceptance_criteria: Fields accept positionX and positionY as percentage values (0-100) from left and top edges
Fields accept width and height as percentage values of overall page dimensions
Fields accept 1-indexed page number and 0-indexed file identifier

title: Recipient Role Configuration
description: Support distinct recipient roles: SIGNER (must sign), APPROVER (must approve before signers sign), CC (receives copy), and VIEWER (can view document).
acceptance_criteria: Recipients can be configured with role 'SIGNER', 'APPROVER', 'CC', or 'VIEWER'
APPROVER must complete action before SIGNER receives invitation
CC recipients receive a copy upon completion without signing
VIEWER recipients can view document without taking action

title: Field Types Support
description: Support adding multiple field types to document pages including SIGNATURE, DATE, and NAME fields assigned to specific recipients.
acceptance_criteria: System accepts field configurations for SIGNATURE, DATE, and NAME types
Fields are mapped to designated recipients based on payload configuration

title: Distribute Envelope for Signing
description: Distribute a draft envelope to its assigned recipients, changing status from DRAFT to PENDING and sending signing invitation emails.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v2/envelope/{id}/distribute transitions envelope status from DRAFT to PENDING
Triggers automated email notification to recipients containing a unique signing link

title: API Rate Limiting Enforcement
description: Enforce a baseline rate limit of 1000 requests per minute per IP address across API endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: API permits up to 1000 requests per minute per IP address
Exceeding rate limit returns HTTP 429 status code

title: Standardized API Error Format
description: Return standardized JSON error objects containing error message description, string error code, and numeric HTTP status code.
acceptance_criteria: API error responses include 'error', 'code', and 'statusCode' fields
Standard status codes (400, 401, 404, 429, 500) follow consistent JSON payload schema
